rules.v: The general labor statute applies in full
rules.vi: UU ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku penuh
rules.n: The Employment Act applies; construction workers and machine operators are listed 'workmen' (First Schedule), and Part 4 (rest days, hours) applies to workmen earning up to $4,500 a month (s. 35(a)). Work permit conditions add obligations on top.
rules.s: Employment Act 1968 s. 2, Part IV · official text: https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/EmA1968?WholeDoc=1

rules.v: No wage floor
rules.vi: Tidak ada batas upah
rules.n: No statutory minimum wage; none was found in the Employment Act. Progressive Wage requirements were not checked in text.
rules.s: Employment Act 1968; MOM, Progressive Wage Model · official guidance: https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/progressive-wage-model/what-is-pwm

rules.v: Statutory limits on hours apply
rules.vi: Batas jam kerja menurut undang-undang berlaku
rules.n: Employment Act Part 4 applies to these workmen: no more than 8 hours a day or 44 a week (s. 38(1)) and one rest day a week (s. 36(1)).

rules.v: May change only on listed grounds, a limited number of times or with official approval
rules.vi: Hanya boleh pindah atas alasan tertentu, terbatas jumlahnya atau dengan persetujuan resmi
rules.n: The worker may work only for the employer and sector named in the permit (Part VI para. 1); the new employer must apply for a new permit (EFMA s. 7). The rule that a transfer needs the current employer's consent was not found in statute.
rules.s: Employment of Foreign Manpower Act 1990; MOM guidance · official guidance:…

rules.v: May join but faces legal limits, or residence status makes membership largely theoretical
rules.vi: Boleh bergabung tetapi dibatasi hukum, atau status tinggal membuat keanggotaan nyaris teoretis
rules.n: Any person over 16 may be a union member (s. 28(1)). Non-citizens may not act as union officers without the Minister's approval (s. 30(3)).
rules.s: Trade Unions Act 1940, s. 30 · official text: https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/TUA1940?WholeDoc=1

rules.v: Fees charged to the worker are capped or regulated
rules.vi: Biaya bagi pekerja dibatasi atau diatur
rules.n: Same cap as for all foreign employees: one month's salary per year of work pass or contract, maximum two months (r. 12(1)(a)); costs outside Singapore excluded (r. 12(2)). Agencies may charge employers without limit (r. 12(3)).
rules.s: Employment Agencies Act 1958 and Rules; Work Passes Regulations 2012, Fourth Schedule · official text: https://sso.agc.gov.sg/SL/EAA1958-S172-2011?WholeDoc=1

rules.v: Only employer-bought private or accident insurance is required
rules.vi: Hanya asuransi swasta atau kecelakaan yang dibeli majikan
rules.n: Employer must buy medical insurance (Part IV para. 4), enrol the worker in a Primary Care Plan (para. 4A, from Dec 2023) and insure against work-injury liability (WICA s. 24). MediShield Life covers only citizens and permanent residents (s. 3(3)).
rules.s: Work Injury Compensation Act 2019; Work Passes Regulations 2012 · official text: https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/WICA2019?WholeDoc=1

rules.v: A dedicated public channel for migrant workers in their languages
rules.vi: Saluran publik khusus pekerja migran dalam bahasa mereka
rules.n: Mandatory mediation by the Commissioner, then the Employment Claims Tribunal (ECA s. 3). Any dedicated migrant worker channel could not be checked.
rules.s: MOM; Migrant Workers' Centre · official guidance: https://www.mom.gov.sg/eservices/fwmomcare

rules.fi: Jalur ke izin tinggal jangka panjang
rules.v: May move to another status that can lead to permanent residence, on conditions
rules.vi: Dapat pindah ke status lain yang dapat mengarah ke izin tinggal tetap, dengan syarat
rules.n: Permanent residence is at the Controller's discretion (IA s. 10); no statutory bar found. Marriage to a citizen or PR needs prior approval (Part VI para. 6). Moving to an S Pass, which may lead to PR, is possible in policy but not shown in statute.
rules.s: MOM, Work Permit and S Pass eligibility; ICA, permanent residence · official guidance: https://www.mom.gov.sg/faq/s-pass/how-do-i-convert-a-work-permit-to-an-s-pass

rules.v: Barred
rules.vi: Dilarang
rules.n: A dependant's pass for spouse or child of any work pass holder is discretionary (Immigration Regulations reg. 11(1)); the exclusion of work permit holders is policy. Marriage to a citizen or PR needs approval and pregnancy in Singapore is barred (Part VI paras 6-7).
rules.s: Work Passes Regulations 2012, Fourth Schedule · official guidance: https://www.mom.gov.sg/passes-and-permits/dependants-pass/eligibility

rules.v: Only administrative regulations under a non-labor statute apply
rules.vi: Hanya peraturan administratif di bawah UU non-ketenagakerjaan
rules.n: The Employment Act excludes domestic workers from 'employee' (s. 2). Terms are set as work permit conditions in the Work Passes Regulations under the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act (Fourth Schedule Parts I-II), not by a labor statute.
rules.s: Employment Act 1968 s. 2; Work Passes Regulations 2012, Fourth Schedule Part I · official text: https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/EmA1968?WholeDoc=1

rules.v: No wage floor
rules.vi: Tidak ada batas upah
rules.n: Singapore has no statutory minimum wage; none was found in the Employment Act. The employer must pay at least the salary declared in the work permit application (Fourth Schedule Part I para. 7), which is a contractual figure, not a floor.
rules.s: Employment of Foreign Manpower Act 1990 · official guidance: https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/progressive-wage-model/what-is-pwm

rules.v: Only minimum rest periods apply, or limits apply with sector exclusions
rules.vi: Hanya waktu istirahat minimum, atau batas berlaku dengan pengecualian sektor
rules.n: No limit on hours: Employment Act Part 4 does not apply. The employer must grant 'adequate rest daily' and one rest day in every 7 days, which may be replaced or paid out by written agreement provided at least one rest day a month is kept (Fourth Schedule Part I paras 10-13B, from 1 Jan 2023).
rules.s: Work Passes Regulations 2012, Fourth Schedule · official text: https://sso.agc.gov.sg/SL/EFMA1990-S569-2012?WholeDoc=1

rules.v: Cannot change without the employer's consent
rules.vi: Tidak dapat pindah tanpa persetujuan majikan
rules.n: The worker may work only for the employer named in the permit (Part VI para. 1) and a new permit must be applied for by the new employer (EFMA s. 7). The rule that a transfer needs the current employer's consent was not found in statute.
rules.s: MOM, transfer of migrant domestic workers · official guidance: https://www.mom.gov.sg/passes-and-permits/work-permit-for-foreign-domestic-worker/transfer-to-a-new-employer

rules.v: May join but faces legal limits, or residence status makes membership largely theoretical
rules.vi: Boleh bergabung tetapi dibatasi hukum, atau status tinggal membuat keanggotaan nyaris teoretis
rules.n: Any person over 16 may be a union member (s. 28(1)), and 'workman' covers anyone under a contract of service. Non-citizens may not act as union officers without the Minister's approval (s. 30(3)).

rules.v: Fees charged to the worker are capped or regulated
rules.vi: Biaya bagi pekerja dibatasi atau diatur
rules.n: Licensed agencies may charge a foreign worker at most one month's salary per year of the work pass or contract (whichever is shorter), up to two months' salary (r. 12(1)(a)). Costs incurred outside Singapore are excluded from the cap (r. 12(2)). Employers may not take kickbacks from agencies (Fourth Schedule Part I para. 19).

rules.v: Only employer-bought private or accident insurance is required
rules.vi: Hanya asuransi swasta atau kecelakaan yang dibeli majikan
rules.n: Employer must buy medical insurance for in-patient and day-surgery costs (Part II para. 4) and personal accident insurance of at least $60,000 (para. 4A). Domestic workers are not covered by the Work Injury Compensation Act (Third Schedule item 3), and MediShield Life covers only citizens and permanent residents (s. 3(3)).

rules.v: A dedicated public channel for migrant workers in their languages
rules.vi: Saluran publik khusus pekerja migran dalam bahasa mereka
rules.n: The Centre for Domestic Employees helpline and MOM's helpline for domestic workers, in several languages.

rules.fi: Jalur ke izin tinggal jangka panjang
rules.v: No route: fixed maximum stay, or time does not count
rules.vi: Tidak ada jalur: masa tinggal maksimum tetap, atau masa tinggal tidak dihitung
rules.n: Permanent residence requires an entry permit issued at the Controller's discretion (IA s. 10); no statutory bar on work permit holders was found. Marriage to a citizen or PR needs the Controller's prior approval (Part VI para. 6). That work permit holders are not eligible for PR is policy.

rules.v: Barred
rules.vi: Dilarang
rules.n: The Immigration Regulations allow a dependant's pass for the spouse or child of any work pass holder at the Controller's discretion (reg. 11(1)), so the bar is policy, not statute. Work permit holders may not marry a citizen or PR without approval or become pregnant in Singapore (Part VI paras 6-7).
rules.s: Work Passes Regulations 2012, Fourth Schedule · official guidance: https://www.mom.gov.sg/passes-and-permits/dependants-pass/eligibility

rules.v: Dedicated instrument with narrower rights, or only selected articles of the general law
rules.vi: Instrumen khusus dengan hak lebih sempit, atau hanya pasal tertentu dari hukum umum
rules.n: Employment Act excludes domestic workers; Employment of Foreign Manpower Act and work permit conditions apply.

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required, no language rule
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib, tanpa aturan bahasa
rules.n: Work permit conditions; standard contracts used by agencies.

rules.v: No minimum wage
rules.vi: Tidak ada upah minimum
rules.n: No minimum wage.

rules.v: Periodic payment required, without further safeguards
rules.vi: Pembayaran berkala wajib, tanpa pengaman lain
rules.n: Monthly salary within 7 days, with records.

rules.v: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
rules.vi: Hanya aturan istirahat harian, atau batas lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: At least 8 continuous hours of rest daily.

rules.v: Weekly rest provided but it may be worked for pay or another day, or is shorter
rules.vi: Istirahat mingguan ada tetapi boleh diganti uang atau hari lain, atau lebih pendek
rules.n: Weekly rest day, which may be compensated; at least one rest day a month that cannot be compensated (2023).

rules.v: None
rules.vi: Tidak ada
rules.n: No statutory annual leave.

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
rules.vi: Hanya aturan umum, tidak khusus pekerja rumah tangga atau tanpa sanksi
rules.n: Employers must not keep the worker's work permit card; passport rule in guidance.

rules.v: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
rules.vi: Hanya standar akomodasi; tinggal di rumah majikan dapat diwajibkan
rules.n: Acceptable accommodation with ventilation and privacy; living in required.

rules.v: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
rules.vi: Pindah hanya dalam keadaan tertentu atau setelah syarat terpenuhi
rules.n: Transfer with the employer's consent or at the end of the contract.

rules.v: Fees capped
rules.vi: Biaya dibatasi
rules.n: Agency fees capped at one month's salary per year of contract, up to two months.

rules.v: Licensing only
rules.vi: Hanya perizinan
rules.n: Licensed agencies with a demerit system.

rules.v: Complaint-based or agency inspection only
rules.vi: Hanya berdasarkan pengaduan atau pengawasan agen
rules.n: Ministry interviews and home visits for first-time workers.

rules.v: Administrative settlement only, or narrower access
rules.vi: Hanya penyelesaian administratif, atau akses lebih sempit
rules.n: Ministry mediation of salary claims.

rules.v: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
rules.vi: Sebagian: hanya perawatan medis, kecelakaan kerja atau asuransi pemberi kerja
rules.n: Compulsory medical and personal accident insurance.

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence

decisions.nm: Parti Liyani v. Public Prosecutor
decisions.pe: An Indonesian domestic worker was accused of theft by her employer’s family soon after she was dismissed, and was convicted. On appeal the High Court cleared her completely and said the accusers may have had an improper motive.
decisions.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia dituduh mencuri oleh keluarga majikan tak lama setelah dipecat, lalu divonis bersalah. Di tingkat banding, Pengadilan Tinggi membebaskannya sepenuhnya dan menyatakan para penuduh mungkin punya motif tidak patut.

decisions.nm: Public Prosecutor v. Gaiyathiri d/o Murugayan
decisions.pe: A young domestic worker from Myanmar was starved and beaten to death by her employer in Singapore. The High Court sentenced the employer to life in prison. Others in the household were also prosecuted.
decisions.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga muda dari Myanmar dibuat kelaparan dan dipukuli sampai meninggal oleh majikannya di Singapura. Pengadilan Tinggi menghukum majikan penjara seumur hidup. Anggota rumah tangga lain juga dituntut.

decisions.nm: Public Prosecutor v. Tay Wee Kiat and Chua Ying Ling
decisions.pe: A couple in Singapore abused their domestic worker from Myanmar for months. On appeal the High Court gave them longer prison terms.
decisions.pi: Pasangan di Singapura menganiaya pekerja rumah tangga mereka dari Myanmar selama berbulan-bulan. Di tingkat banding, Pengadilan Tinggi memperberat hukuman penjara mereka.
